##### Project general facts

Lume Residences, presented by a distinguished developer, showcases a sleek silhouette defined by clean lines and a vibrant façade, while floor‑to‑ceiling windows usher abundant daylight into every studio, one bedroom and two bedroom home. Each apartment embraces a smart layout that balances open communal areas with private retreats, reflecting a forward‑thinking approach to urban design. The development’s signature touches include brushed gold accents that catch the light and reflective surfaces that add depth to the living environment.

The residence benefits from its placement within a lively, well‑established neighbourhood, granting residents immediate proximity to the community’s parks, schools and shopping centres, which together support a balanced routine of work, relaxation and social interaction. Though internal communal facilities are not detailed, the building’s design encourages a seamless connection between indoor spaces and the surrounding environment, fostering a sense of community without sacrificing personal privacy. This integration ensures that everyday convenience and a vibrant social fabric are always within reach.

Interiors are dressed in an off‑white palette complemented by brushed gold highlights, while high‑quality laminate wood flooring runs beneath every step. Custom cabinetry and carefully selected finishes reinforce the contemporary aesthetic, and kitchens are equipped with Electrolux appliances that marry style with practicality. All homes are delivered unfurnished, offering occupants the freedom to personalize their space atop a refined, design‑led foundation.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle, a circular‑shaped enclave in the heart of Dubai, unfurls tree‑lined streets that invite leisurely strolls and daily encounters with nature’s calm. The neighbourhood’s tranquil parks punctuate the landscape, providing open green spaces where residents can unwind amidst a serene backdrop. Its layout of spacious villas and apartments creates a distinctive residential tapestry that feels both expansive and intimate.

Within Jumeirah Village Circle, families benefit from a network of reputable schools that cater to diverse educational needs, ensuring convenient access to quality learning environments. Shopping centres dot the area, offering a variety of retail and dining options that satisfy everyday errands and spontaneous outings alike. Recreational facilities, thoughtfully woven into the community’s design, supply venues for fitness, play and communal gatherings, enhancing the overall quality of life.

The broader setting of Jumeirah Village Circle balances peaceful residential charm with strategic connectivity to Dubai’s bustling hubs, allowing professionals to enjoy a tranquil home base without sacrificing access to the city’s commercial pulse. Natural beauty coexists with modern infrastructure, presenting an appealing blend of serenity and convenience. This harmonious mix positions the neighbourhood as a coveted address for those seeking both calm and connectivity.
